# 500.00 USD moved from a US dollar account holding nothing to another, and
# what follows from the first account being left below zero.
#
# A at −500.00 owes 500.00 US dollars, so the transfer is a borrowing: 500.00
# arrives on the held side at B and 500.00 on the owed side at A, each opening
# a cost basis at the 1.35 the transfer is stated at. The rest of the book is
# written in the files layered on this one:
#
# - usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account_then_sold.txt sells B's 500.00 at 1.40;
# - usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account_then_refilled.txt refills A from C;
# - usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account_then_income_into_it.txt pays 1,000.00
#   USD of income into A, crossing zero in one split.
#
# USD stands at 1.30 on 2034-01-05, 1.35 on 2034-01-10 and 1.40 on 2034-02-01.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2034-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2034-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2034-01-01 open Assets:USD C
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2034-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 10000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -10000.00 CAD

2034-01-05 * "Buy 1,000.00 USD at 1.30 into C"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD C 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "1300.00"
		guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000003"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1300.00 CAD

2034-01-10 * "Move 500.00 USD from an empty A to B"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD A -500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-675.00"
		guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000001"
	Assets:USD B 500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "675.00"
		guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000002"
